senses.gloss: f. (annona) prop. annual produce, hence ration, or portions of provision granted to courtiers as salaries or pensions.
units: Gen. R. s. 47 the king מעלה לו א׳ raised an annona in his behalf, i.e. granted him a pension.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87">Gen. R. s. 87</cite> <he>אני חותכת א׳ שלך</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="Q01901"><he>פרנסה</he></cite>) I shall cut down (reduce) thy pension; a. fr.—Pl. <he>אַנּוֹנוֹת</he>, <he>אַנּוֹנִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41:4">Ex. R. s. 41</cite> <cite ref="A02146"><he>אנונית</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:5">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> <he>נגבין אונניות</he> (corr. acc.) annonæ are collected from them.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <he>אַנּוֹנִים</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A02146"><he>אַנּוֹנָס</he></cite> annonas, acc. pl., incorr. ed. <he>אנינוס</he>).
